learning_outcomes.text: The student can structure their Bachelor's thesis in terms of time and content.
They master procedures and tools for preparing scientific work.
The task definition of the Bachelor's thesis is designed accordingly, and fundamental information for processing the Bachelor's thesis is developed and structured.
They are able to break down complex tasks into work packages and transfer them into a time schedule.

assessment_rules: Student knowledge is assessed by a written assignment or an oral examination, corresponding to an ungraded performance (XS). The type of examination will be announced upon registration of the Bachelor's thesis.
bibliography: Hering, L., Hering, H.: Technische Berichte, Vieweg, 4. Aufl., 2003
